📌 SQL Series Part 6: CREATE TABLE  (Create & Insert)

Is Short mein seekho:
✅ Syntax: CREATE TABLE table_name ( column_name data_type, ... );
✅ Use snake_case for column names and end statement with a semicolon.
✅ Place commas between columns, no trailing comma after the last column.
✅ Define primary key and other constraints within column definition.
✅ Common mistake: extra comma before closing parenthesis causes error.

💻 Example query:
CREATE TABLE employees (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(50),
  dept VARCHAR(20),
  salary INT,
  city VARCHAR(30)
);

❌ Common mistake: CREATE TABLE t ( id INT, name VARCHAR(50), );
✔️ Sahi tareeka: CREATE TABLE t ( id INT, name VARCHAR(50) );
💡 Kyun: Last column ke baad comma = syntax error. Comma sirf beech mein ✋

description:

INSERT INTO in SQL seekho 30 sec mein.
SQL interview ke liye yeh golden rule yaad rakho!

📌 SQL Series Part 7: INSERT INTO  (Create & Insert)

Is Short mein seekho:
✅ Basic syntax: INSERT INTO table (cols) VALUES (...)
✅ Text aur dates hamesha single quotes ' ' mein likho
✅ Multiple rows daalne ke liye ( ),( ) structure use karo
✅ Column names explicitly likhna safe aur best practice hai
✅ Double quotes " " se data insert nahi hota, error aayega

💻 Example query:
INSERT INTO employees
(id, name, dept, salary, city)
VALUES
(1,'Aarav','IT',60000,'Delhi'),
(2,'Meera','HR',45000,'Mumbai');

❌ Common mistake: VALUES (3, "Kabir", "Sales")
✔️ Sahi tareeka: VALUES (3, 'Kabir', 'Sales')
💡 Kyun: Standard SQL mein "double" = column naam. PostgreSQL error dega, text hamesha 'single' ✅

description:
Alias (AS) in SQL se column ka naam turant badlo!
SQL in Hindi tutorial – interview ke liye must!
Dekho kaise simple AS se result mein rename hota hai.

📌 SQL Series Part 10: Alias (AS)  (Select Basics)

Is Short mein seekho:
✅ Alias (AS) sirf result set mein temporary column naam set karta hai
✅ Table ki asli column name kabhi change nahi hoti
✅ Calculations ke saath AS ka use karke readable output banao
✅ Alias ko WHERE clause mein directly use nahi kar sakte
✅ Example query mein employee_name aur yearly_salary kaise milte hain

💻 Example query:
SELECT
  name AS employee_name,
  salary * 12 AS yearly_salary
FROM employees;

❌ Common mistake: SELECT salary*12 AS yearly FROM employees WHERE yearly › 600000;
✔️ Sahi tareeka: SELECT salary*12 AS yearly FROM employees WHERE salary*12 › 600000;
💡 Kyun: WHERE, SELECT se pehle chalta hai. Alias tab tak bana hi nahi 🤷 (ORDER BY mein chalega)

  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
   PARTITION BY dept
   ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rn
 FROM employees)

FROM r WHERE rn = 1;

📌 SQL Series Part 68: Recursive CTE  (CTE & Subqueries)

Is Short mein seekho:

✅ Recursive part jo khud ko call kare
✅ Infinite loop se bachne ke liye stop condition zaroori

  SELECT 1 AS n
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n + 1 FROM nums
  WHERE n ‹ 5
)

📌 SQL Series Part 79: Manager se zyada salary  (Interview Prep)

Is Short mein seekho:
✅ Self JOIN ka use karke same table ko do alias me join karo
✅ e.manager_id = m.id se employee aur manager link hota hai
✅ WHERE e.salary › m.salary se higher salary wale employees filter hote hain
✅ INNER JOIN hi kaafi, LEFT JOIN galat result dega
✅ Result columns: employee name, salary, manager name, manager salary

💻 Example query:

  m.name AS manager,
  m.salary AS mgr_salary
FROM employees e
JOIN employees m
  ON e.manager_id = m.id
WHERE e.salary › m.salary;

❌ Common mistake: LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.id WHERE e.salary › m.salary
✔️ Sahi tareeka: JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.id WHERE e.salary › m.salary
💡 Kyun: Aarav ka m.salary NULL → compare UNKNOWN → row gayab. LEFT JOIN se sirf confusion

title: EXPLAIN ANALYZE se SQL query ki speed ka raaz? 🔍 #shorts
description:
Query slow lag rahi hai? EXPLAIN ANALYZE in SQL se bottleneck pakdo!
SQL interview ke liye best practice: har query ka execution plan check karo.
SQL in Hindi mein aasan tareeke se sikho.

📌 SQL Series Part 82: EXPLAIN ANALYZE  (Advanced Basics)

Is Short mein seekho:
✅ EXPLAIN ANALYZE se execution plan milta hai
✅ type, rows, Extra columns se bottleneck identify karo
✅ Index ya column selection se plan ko optimize karo
✅ Har query ke liye plan check karna best practice hai
✅ Galat query (WHERE missing) full table scan dikhata

💻 Example query:
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 5;
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 5;

❌ Common mistake: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM orders; -- WHERE missing, plan full table dikhata
✔️ Sahi tareeka: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 5; -- specific filter se index usage dikhai
💡 Kyun: WHERE bina index ka fayda nahi dikhata, galat plan se optimization galat hota hai
